heroTitle: Planning for retirement, through retirement, and the years leading up to it.
heroSub: The questions change depending on where you are. Someone twenty years from retirement has different decisions to make than someone who's already there. We help you understand where you are today and make a plan for what comes next.

groups.title: In Retirement
groups.body:
Congratulations. You made it.

You've spent years building toward this, and now comes the part you've been planning for: deciding how your money will support the life you want to live. We help you work out how much you can comfortably spend, where your income should come from, and how your investments, taxes, and protection fit together, so you can enjoy this chapter with confidence.

As your spending, health, family, or priorities change, we keep adjusting the plan with you.
groups.listIntro: What we may work through includes:
items: How much income the plan can reasonably support
Social Security, pensions, and investment withdrawals
Investment risk and how the portfolio supports spending
Long-term care and other protection needs
What you want to leave to family or other people and causes you care about

groups.title: Approaching Retirement
groups.body:
This is an exciting stretch. Retirement is coming into view, and you still have time and plenty of options to make the most of it.

The decisions you make now can shape the years ahead: when to retire, how much to save, when to take Social Security, how your 401(k) and other accounts fit together, and how much investment risk makes sense as the date gets closer.

We help you see where your current path leads and build a strategy to get the most out of the years ahead, while you still have the most options.
groups.listIntro: What we may work through includes:
items: Your retirement timeline and what it may take to get there
Cash needs around the retirement transition
Insurance and protection while you still have time to make changes

groups.title: Still Building
groups.body:
The best time to prepare for retirement is early, and you're already thinking about it.

Starting now gives you the biggest advantage there is: time. Time to build savings, let your investments work, put the right protection in place, and adjust as life changes.

We help make sure your saving, investing, cash flow, and protection are moving you toward the future you want, and that you have a plan for getting there.
groups.listIntro: What we may work through includes:
items: Building toward the income you may want later

notFitBody:
We tend to work best with people who have been thoughtful with their money and want to make the most of what they've built.

They like understanding the why behind a decision, want every part of their financial life working together, and value a long-term relationship with someone who knows their situation.

If that sounds like you, a Clarity Call is an easy way to find out whether we're a good fit.
closingHeading: Want to see if we're a fit?
closingSub: A Clarity Call is a 15 to 30 minute conversation about where you are, what you're trying to accomplish, and whether the work we do fits what you're looking for.
